local_patches.summary: OPEN PIN — the vendored LookML fixes exist in upstream commit 16ad063 but are absent from the current default HEAD 21f3167; re-vendoring from default would regress filter normalization, dynamicParameters, and ${TABLE} branch handling.

LOCAL PATCH on top of the 16ad063 bundle: (1) lookSqlToSigmaRules uppercases ${TABLE}.col identifiers so calculated dimensions (CASE, comparisons) emit Sigma column refs instead of raw lowercase SQL names; (2) a bare ${name} that names another dimension of the same view is a field reference, not parameter substitution: it is resolved through expandFieldRefs (yesno refs expand recursively with a cycle guard) instead of being skipped; a pure alias (sql: ${other} ;;) stays skipped and is left out of fieldDisplayMap so refs to it stay unresolved, and a field-ref calc the rules cannot translate is skipped with a warning instead of emitted as a fake [TABLE/DIM_NAME] column; (3) in Custom SQL (derived_table) elements, qualifyPhysRefs maps display-name refs to physical columns back to [Custom SQL/COL] (bare display names do not resolve). Re-vendoring upstream 3fd4411 reproduces this bundle byte-for-byte except bundler path comments. Regression: scripts/test-lookml-calc-refs.mjs + fixtures/trip-legs-calc-refs.
local_patches.upstream_pr: PENDING: the upstream port (commit 3fd4411, stacked on 16ad063) is not merged upstream yet. Until it is merged and re-vendored, keep this entry or a re-vendor drops the fix.

note: Self-contained bundled artifact, not source. The three fixes landed in upstream commit 16ad063, but that commit is not present on the repository's current default HEAD; keep this bundle pinned until the upstream branch is merged, then re-vendor and retire the OPEN PIN entry. A second local patch (calculated-dimension ${TABLE}.col and ${field} refs) is carried on top of the bundle; see local_patches.
